item.title: 'Star Trek' at 60: A legacy of exploration and optimism
item.description: The original series aired for only three seasons but spawned numerous spin-offs and films, cementing its cultural impact over six decades.

item.title: Canada-U.S. trade war escalates: What you need to know
item.description: Canada imposed tariffs on $20 billion of U.S. goods in retaliation. The dispute could have wide-ranging economic and political consequences.

item.title: Is the economy taking a C-shaped turn?
item.description: A K-shaped recovery means the rich and poor diverge. A C-shaped one suggests they are converging. Experts debate which pattern fits current trends.

item.title: The 2026 midterm general election season begins. Here's what to watch
item.description: The week after Labor Day marks the unofficial start of the general election season. President Trump's low approval ratings and Democratic enthusiasm are setting the stage for competitive races.
